args.message:
Fix money rounding to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

round_money documented banker's rounding but used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to fail
(e.g. 2.665 rounded to 2.67 instead of 2.66).

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.py`'s `round_money` documented banker's rounding (per FIN-212) but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`.

## Changes
- Switched rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed (previously failing `test_half_even` now passes: `2.675 -> 2.68`, `2.665 -> 2.66`).

## Summary
`src/money.py`'s `round_money` documented banker's rounding (per FIN-212) but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py`.

## Changes
- Switched rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` (original fix commit) and `ci-0002` (after merging latest main) both passed. The previously failing `test_half_even` now passes: `2.675 -> 2.68`, `2.665 -> 2.66`.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the failure**: `src/money.py`'s `round_money` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring specifying `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` per FIN-212, so `test_half_even` failed on the `2.665 → 2.66` case (banker's rounding rounds halves to even).
2. **Created branch** `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding` and committed the fix: switched the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.
3. **Ran CI** — passed (run `ci-0001`). The branch had fallen behind main, so I merged main in and re-ran CI — passed again (run `ci-0002`).
4. **Opened PR #101** against main with alex requested as reviewer: https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101

The PR is open and awaiting alex's review; merging into main was left to the normal code-owner approval process.
